description:
AI-powered desktop workspace manager

CoolDesk is an AI-powered desktop workspace manager that organizes your browser tabs, apps, and workflows. It features a global spotlight search, smart tab grouping, workspace management, and real-time sync across browsers.
What's new in 2.0.17
✨ Added
- Browse — an in-app browser. The desktop app is now one screen: tabs for web pages, files, folders and terminals, with a side panel for finding things (Home, Tabs, Files, Shelf, Notes, Page). Pages use native WebKit with built-in ad/tracker blocking, highlights and notes, find in page, copy as Markdown, per-site dark mode and screenshots. Back/Forward, ⌘1–9 to switch tabs.
- Home — blank tabs show your workspaces on top and what's open below: running apps, browser tabs, widgets, folders and dev servers.
- Terminal — terminal tabs and a bottom drawer (Ctrl+) with your real login shell. Type > cmdor/run cmd` in the spotlight to run a command in a terminal tab, and a compact Shell card in the docked sidebar.
- File viewers — Markdown/HTML preview, JSON tree, CSV/TSV table, audio, and archives (zip, tar, 7z, rar): browse inside, preview, Extract here, or Compress to .zip from the right-click menu.
- Page clips — pick a table, chart or block on a page and save it as a workspace note.
- Clipboard history (opt-in, Settings → Behaviour) — everything you copy in the side dock: text, code, links, colors, images and files, with preview, pin, drag-out and Save to Shelf. Password-manager copies and text that looks like a password, key or token are skipped; choose which kinds get recorded.
- Passwords (opt-in, Settings → Behaviour) — a small encrypted password vault in the side dock, locked with a master password (Argon2id + XChaCha20-Poly1305, stored only on this device). Click to copy a password — it's hidden from clipboard managers and cleared after 30 seconds. Locks itself after 5 minutes idle. There is no recovery if you forget the master password.
- Real browser history in search — the spotlight now searches Chrome, Arc, Brave, Edge, Vivaldi and Chromium history (all profiles), and picking a page that's already open switches to its tab.
- Page guard — background pages sleep when idle or heavy, crashed pages recover, a "using a lot of CPU" notice with Stop page, and per-site camera/mic permissions and mute.
💬 Changed
- Smarter search ranking shared across tabs, links, bookmarks and history: words in any order, one-typo tolerance, and near-duplicate URLs collapsed into one row.
- Docked sidebar gets an Active card (running apps and open tabs) and shows the two most active workspaces.
- Spotlight's Markdown preview renders like the Browse preview.
- Page stats show real memory (physical footprint) and CPU%, including CoolDesk's own WebKit processes.
- Restyled Clipboard and Passwords cards; wallpaper mode no longer turns their buttons into glass pills or hides their inputs.
🐛 Fixed
- Docked sidebar and bottom bar painting solid black instead of see-through.
- Couldn't go fullscreen after undocking.
- Hotkeys and dock show/hide breaking once a browser page was open.
🔒 Security
- Browser pages and web-app windows can't call app commands; capabilities scoped to CoolDesk's own windows.
- Camera/mic asked per site instead of granted to every page.
- Local sidecar no longer accepts WebSocket connections from arbitrary localhost pages.
📦 Install

Platform             │Download

                     │CoolDesk.CoolDesk
─────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS (Apple Silicon)│CoolDesk_2.0.17_aarch64.dmg — or via Homebrew (below)
─────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

brew tap abhayraghuwanshi/cooldesk https://github.com/abhayraghuwanshi/cooldesk-extension
brew install --cask cooldesk   # or: brew upgrade --cask cooldesk
